profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Java | Microservices | API Development | Distributed Systems | AWS | Kubernetes | Software Architecture
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 20+ years of experience in backend development, distributed systems, and software architecture. Over 15 years of experience as a Software Architect and Technical Lead, designing and modernizing high-availability, large-scale backend platforms across financial services, ecommerce, and enterprise environments.

Strong expertise in Java backend engineering, including microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and enterprise integrations. Proven background in building systems focused on scalability, reliability, performance, fault tolerance, and observability, with an emphasis on long-term maintainability.

Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker, including cloud-native architectures, on-premise to cloud migrations, platform modernization, and deployment automation. Deep experience with distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, and observability using OpenTelemetry (OTel), as well as improving developer experience through internal frameworks and tooling.

Throughout my career, I have worked on and led initiatives involving:
- Backend engineering for mission-critical financial systems (payments, credit, insurance, core banking)
- Ecommerce platforms and third-party integrations
- Microservices-based architectures and platform engineering
- Cloud migration and system modernization
- Highly available and scalable systems operating under strict reliability requirements

Currently focused on Backend Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Software Architecture, collaborating with distributed teams, influencing technical strategy, and delivering robust, scalable backend platforms built for growth.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Framework & Platform Engineering
Owned and evolved an internal Java backend framework used across the organization, improving performance, resiliency, observability (OpenTelemetry), and developer experience. Influenced architectural standards and cloud-native adoption at scale.

Digital Products Stability
Improved availability, reliability, and performance of critical backend systems by identifying bottlenecks, strengthening fault tolerance, and enhancing monitoring and alerting.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Backend Engineering · Software Architecture · Microservices Architecture · Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · OpenTelemetry (OTel) · Observability · Performance Optimization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and evolved the 3PIP backend platform, enabling merchants to independently create, validate, test, and manage promotional deals via self-service APIs. Reduced operational overhead, improved partner autonomy, and increased visibility and control over the deal lifecycle.

Led and contributed to the migration from on-premise infrastructure to AWS, modernizing the platform with Docker, Kubernetes, deployment automation, and cloud-native practices. These efforts significantly improved scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency under variable traffic and integration load.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Java · RESTful WebServices · Design Patterns · Redis · Web Services · JUnit · Maven · JDK · Software Development · MySQL · Scrum · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies · Java Development · Architecture · Apache Kafka · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · PostgreSQL · Solution Architecture · Enterprise Architecture

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Worked on a microservices-based platform responsible for managing product sizing and packing based on retail planning requirements. The system supported supply chain operations by automating packing decisions, integrating multiple services, and enabling asynchronous communication through messaging. Contributed to backend development, service integration, and system reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Microservices · Java · RESTful WebServices · Design Patterns · Web Services · JUnit · Spring Boot · JDK · Software Development · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Java Development · Architecture · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · Spring · Solution Architecture · Enterprise Architecture

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Acted as Solutions Architect and technical leader for complex enterprise and integration initiatives across financial services, telecommunications, public sector, and defense domains. Led system design, defined integration architectures and patterns, guided technology selection, and supported development teams throughout the full delivery lifecycle.

Worked on multiple mission-critical systems, including:
- Military command-and-control (C3) system integration using open-source ESBs
- Large-scale banking systems (credit, payments, insurance, core banking, remittances)
- Enterprise integration platforms and service orchestration
- Highly configurable, service-oriented enterprise platforms

Designed and implemented SOA, ESB, and event-driven architectures, conducted proof-of-concepts, and delivered systems requiring high availability, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Design Patterns · JUnit · Maven · JDK · Software Development · MySQL · Scrum · Java Enterprise Edition · Hibernate · Agile Methodologies · Java Development · JSF · Architecture · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · PostgreSQL · Spring · Solution Architecture · Enterprise Architecture

positions.title: Java Programmer
positions.description: Worked on the rewrite of a legacy ERP system into a Java-based client-server architecture. Contributed to backend logic, data persistence, reporting, and system modernization. The platform supported core business operations for small and midsize companies and was used by approximately 1,000 customers across Brazil.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Design Patterns · JUnit · JDK · Software Development · Hibernate · Agile Methodologies · Java Development · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · Spring

positions.title: Java Programmer
positions.description: Participated in the development of the company’s first ERP product in a startup environment. Worked on backend logic, client-server communication, and database integration, contributing to the foundation of the company’s core product.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Design Patterns · JUnit · JDK · Software Development · MySQL · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Java Development · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · PostgreSQL
